matching_policy.regex_engine: PCRE2 for generation; patterns are restricted to a .NET-compatible subset for independent verification
matching_policy.granularity: Non-overlapping semantic-token matches per source line
matching_policy.token_boundary: Terms use negative ASCII letter/digit/underscore lookarounds so incidental identifier, hash, and base64 substrings do not match.

scope.description: All tracked and in-scope newly added Markdown and JSON files in the public repository, excluding this generated ledger to avoid self-reference.
scope.self_exclusion_reason: Self-inclusion would recursively alter occurrence counts and cannot produce a stable ledger.
scope.content_policy: Only public repository path, line number, count, term identifier, classification, and rule basis are recorded; no source excerpts, private locators, or answer-bearing content are copied.

classification_policy.heading_scope: ATX Markdown heading applies to its section and nested subsections until a heading of equal or lesser depth resets the stack.
classification_policy.current_status_heading_regex: ^(?:(?:Current|current|Present|present) .*(?:status|state|disposition|authority|boundary|assessment|architecture|amendment|identities)|[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} evaluator-deferral (?:closeout status through WP3|disposition)|Final retirement boundary|Subsequent disposition)$
classification_policy.json_policy: JSON has no Markdown section overrides and uses its document default.

classifications.current_normative: Accepted authority, requirements, policy, or active plan language.
classifications.current_status: Present repository or work-package status language, including current-disposition sections in historical documents.
classifications.historical_record: Preserved historical, prior, original, predecessor, append-only, or retired-plan language that is not current authority.

terms.label: B2 C2 Stage D and private held-out authorization
held-out PASS EVALUATOR_ERROR and product-verdict language
M1 active/complete and M2/M3 transition language

expected_allowed_contexts: negative exit criteria in the active closeout plan
current status stating that prior gates are retired, deferred, or superseded
